original_prompt: Write a Helm chart deploying a Redis cache: StatefulSet, headless Service, PersistentVolumeClaim, and a Secret for the Redis password.

Task: Write a Helm chart deploying a Redis cache: StatefulSet, headless Service, PersistentVolumeClaim, and a Secret for the Redis password.

Output only the Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: redis-cache
description: A production-grade Helm chart for deploying Redis as a cache with persistence
type: application
version: 1.0.0
appVersion: "7.2.4"
keywords:
  - redis
  - cache
  - key-value
  - database
maintainers:
  - name: platform-team
    email: platform@example.com
home: https://redis.io
sources:
  - https://github.com/redis/redis
icon: https://redis.io/images/redis-white.png
---
# FILE: values.yaml
# Default values for redis-cache.
nameOverride: ""
fullnameOverride: ""

image:
  repository: redis
  tag: "7.2.4-alpine"
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent

imagePullSecrets: []

replicaCount: 1

# Redis authentication
auth:
  enabled: true
  # If empty, a random 32-character password will be generated on first install.
  password: ""
  # Use an existing secret instead of creating one. Must contain key 'redis-password'.
  existingSecret: ""

service:
  type: ClusterIP
  port: 6379
  annotations: {}

persistence:
  enabled: true
  storageClass: ""
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  size: 8Gi
  annotations: {}

# Redis configuration tuned for cache use-case
config:
  maxmemory: "256mb"
  maxmemoryPolicy: "allkeys-lru"
  appendonly: "no"
  save: ""
  timeout: "300"
  tcpKeepalive: "60"
  databases: 16
  # Additional raw redis.conf directives
  extraConfig: |
    tcp-backlog 511
    loglevel notice

resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 100m
    memory: 128Mi
  limits:
    cpu: 1000m
    memory: 512Mi

podSecurityContext:
  fsGroup: 1000
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 1000
  runAsGroup: 1000
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault

securityContext:
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 1000
  runAsGroup: 1000
  capabilities:
    drop:
      - ALL

livenessProbe:
  initialDelaySeconds: 30
  periodSeconds: 10
  timeoutSeconds: 5
  successThreshold: 1
  failureThreshold: 5

readinessProbe:
  initialDelaySeconds: 5
  periodSeconds: 5
  timeoutSeconds: 3
  successThreshold: 1
  failureThreshold: 5

startupProbe:
  initialDelaySeconds: 10
  periodSeconds: 5
  timeoutSeconds: 3
  failureThreshold: 30

nodeSelector: {}
tolerations: []
affinity: {}
topologySpreadConstraints: []

podAnnotations: {}
podLabels: {}

serviceAccount:
  create: true
  annotations: {}
  name: ""

podDisruptionBudget:
  enabled: false
  minAvailable: 1

networkPolicy:
  enabled: false
  ingressNamespaceSelector: {}
  ingressPodSelector: {}

updateStrategy:
  type: RollingUpdate

terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
---
# FILE: templates/_helpers.tpl
{{/*
Expand the name of the chart.
*/}}
{{- define "redis-cache.name" -}}
{{- default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}

{{/*
Create a default fully qualified app name.
*/}}
{{- define "redis-cache.fullname" -}}
{{- if .Values.fullnameOverride }}
{{- .Values.fullnameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- else }}
{{- $name := default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride }}
{{- if contains $name .Release.Name }}
{{- .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- else }}
{{- printf "%s-%s" .Release.Name $name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{/*
Chart name and version label.
*/}}
{{- define "redis-cache.chart" -}}
{{- printf "%s-%s" .Chart.Name .Chart.Version | replace "+" "_" | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}

{{/*
Common labels
*/}}
{{- define "redis-cache.labels" -}}
helm.sh/chart: {{ include "redis-cache.chart" . }}
{{ include "redis-cache.selectorLabels" . }}
{{- if .Chart.AppVersion }}
app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion | quote }}
{{- end }}
app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .Release.Service }}
app.kubernetes.io/component: cache
app.kubernetes.io/part-of: {{ include "redis-cache.name" . }}
{{- end }}

{{/*
Selector labels
*/}}
{{- define "redis-cache.selectorLabels" -}}
app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "redis-cache.name" . }}
app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
{{- end }}

{{/*
Headless service name
*/}}
{{- define "redis-cache.headlessServiceName" -}}
{{- printf "%s-headless" (include "redis-cache.fullname" .) | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
